Made From Cow Dung

Every piece begins with sacred cow dung

Every piece is shaped by hand and dried in the sun by rural women artisans, with no plastic and no chemicals anywhere in the process. That's what gives each Utsav piece its character, and keeps it close to tradition.

Fully Biodegradable

Once used, it simply returns to the soil as manure.

Made by Rural Women

Each piece is shaped by hand by women artisans in Indian villages.

Rooted in Ritual

Diyas, idols, dhoop and malas, made for everyday puja.

Gifting with Purpose

A thoughtful choice for festivals, weddings, temples and office desks alike.
